network.stated_total_quote: Dr. Morsch understood the importance rural hospitals have on their communities. His desire was to recruit reliable, high-quality healthcare Physicians, Physician Assistants and Nurse Practitioners willing to help create a work-life balance for the local medical staff, and for themselves. Nearly three decades later, partnering with over 250 sites and hundreds of providers, this is exactly what Docs Who Care continues to deliver.
network.coverage_note: Docs Who Care is a medical staffing agency rather than an educational institution, so it does not have Erasmus+ partnerships or academic campuses. The evidence lists partner hospitals but does not provide a specific list of these institutions.
